description: Restore the measured-fast flag1 medium reduced kernels after barrier variants regressed. Final candidate retains PDL overlap, fused routing/scatter, rest-only TF32+FP32 repair/gate, accurate 3xTF32 gate, unordered AQ gate, and persistent auxiliaries/bases. 39/39 passes; mixed n512 98088.333 us; full 25150.416354 vs parent 25210.198.

Added cluster-secondary PDL launch support and a heterogeneous med/cluster chain. The 25 non-projector remainder rows run in one full-n C=5 cluster primary; k608 then k384 reduced grids launch as dependents; five two-level rows use one projector solve; one final scatter. Valid 39/39. Mixed1024 improves 211154.379->105322.177 us and aggregate 26524.404->25161.131 us, within 0.04% of parent.

Enable the medium kernel's FP32 one-barrier reduction and carried-next-reflector-norm path only for the overlapped dense/PSD pair (flag 25), targeting its post-cluster tail. 39/39 passes, but 10-run mixed n512 mean regresses to 98491.814 us vs 98113.889; extra carry work outweighs barrier savings. Full 25174.895123 is noise-driven.

Isolate the one-barrier FP32 reductions (flag 9) without carried-next-norm work. Valid; mixed n512 98275.917 us over 5 runs is closer but still ~0.16 ms slower than flag1 best 98113.889. Reduction broadcast removal alone is neutral-to-negative here.

Restore FP32 dense/PSD reduced backtransforms. Replace the rest route's true-FP32 Q^TQ gate with the symmetric two-product 3xTF32 Gram already validated by the low-rank gate. 39/39 passes; mixed n512 improves to 98354.391 us and full metric to 25183.860413.

Replaced four mask/nonzero compactions with one fused four-way route classifier, one argsort and one four-counter sync; kept each route numerical solver unchanged, packed outputs by route, then fused final Q/L scatter in one Triton launch. Valid 39/39. Mixed512 measured 104036.766 us; full geomean 25196.551 us versus parent 25210.198 us.

Persist and reuse rest-cluster v/p auxiliaries plus the identity matrix by (batch,n,C,device), complementing the existing large scratch/T/bounds caches. 39/39 passes; mixed n512 improves modestly to 98191.775 us, full metric 25204.063494 (unrelated-shape noise vs trial13).

Separated clustered compact-WY Gram and T shared tiles, removing the per-column Gram snapshot and one warp synchronization; expanded the stage-tail SMEM reservation without changing the hot triangle limit. Validation 39/39; branch-best 25204.208 us, mixed512 99511.629 us.

Cache the exact deterministic Gaussian Omega/complement bases by (B,n,k,device), eliminating four RNG launches and repeated allocations on the mixed dense/PSD branches. Read-only bases preserve algorithm and outputs. 39/39 passes; mixed n512 98113.889 us (~0.08 ms gain, near noise), full 25209.101912.

Merged the PSD-only retained A^2*Omega range seed with the exact three-way n2048 spectral divide while preserving both route guards. Full validation passed 39/39. Aggregate improved to 25210.198 us; mixed512 measured 104103.508 us and dense n2048 86191.059 us. Nsys shows no cross-route interference: mixed512 keeps one 44.523 ms cluster solve, while n2048 keeps two 28.037 ms cluster leaves and 40.248 ms of main TF32 GEMMs.

Restore dense-first dependency order and run only the rest-route WY backtransform in plain TF32. The existing two FP32 Newton-Schulz repair steps plus per-matrix residual gate make this safe: 39/39 validation passes; mixed n512 improves to 98768.594 us (~1.90 ms over prior best).

Changed generator continuation order from PSD-then-dense to packed dense-then-PSD after the same dependency chain. Valid 39/39. Mixed512 measured 100665.011 versus 100779.047 us (-0.11%, within noise); full geomean improved 25256.885->25243.322 us in this run.

Confirmation of retaining/gathering only A^2*Omega for PSD k256. Validation remained 39/39; mixed512 reproduced the gain at 104.119ms after 103.859ms, and aggregate improved to branch-best 25247.953 us versus parent 25267.837 (matched remeasure 25260.875).

Restore explicit rest NS. Evaluate the permutation-invariant rest residual gate before sorting and gather only returned Q/L, eliminating the full AQ gather. Valid; mixed n512 98425.928 us is neutral (+0.07 ms within noise), full metric 25248.179496. Profile on required fifth-trial cadence.

Reduced multiway slack from six to three vectors (0.125%). Full validation passed; n=2048 measured 88075 us mean, 86258 us best, and 116303 us worst. Aggregate improved to 25251.779, beating the parent metric by 16.058.

Generated a contiguous width-224 PSD Gaussian tail directly instead of generating width256 and slicing. Validation passed; mixed512 measured 104.250ms and aggregate 25255.163 us. The changed deterministic random sequence offset the expected RNG/layout saving and did not beat the prior 25247.953 result.

Restore C=3 and launch the smaller PSD secondary before dense, aiming to release the dense solve earlier through a short dependent stage. Valid but mixed n512 is 101116.862 us, about 0.45% slower than dense-first; profile required on fifth-trial cadence.

Restored the single cluster-first dependency chain and replaced the two-thread low-rank coordinator with a generator-staged solver: prepare dense/PSD sequentially, yield both Bk blocks, launch the dependency chain, then resume the exact PSD and dense continuations. Removes 96 net lines, host scheduling, and backend-setting races. Valid 39/39. Mixed512 improved 101393.190->100779.047 us; full geomean 25256.885 us.

Restored A^2*Omega reuse to PSD k256 only and removed cross-stage overhead: the classifier now retains only A^2*Omega, and mixed multi-bucket routing gathers it only for the PSD rows (not A*Omega and not dense rows). Validation passed; mixed512 improved to 103.859ms versus matched parent 104.744ms, and aggregate reached branch-best 25257.073 us.

Reduced dynamic multiway slack to exactly one vector via ceil(0.0001*2048). Full validation passed; unlike zero slack, the one completion vector preserves quality. n=2048 improved to 86788 us mean and 84055 us best, worst 115472 us. Aggregate 25257.468 beats the parent by 10.369.

Specialized the nb=32 compact-T recurrences to warp 0: column dependencies use warp barriers, followed by one CTA handoff before the parallel store, in both med and cluster builders. Validation 39/39; branch-best aggregate 25258.879 us, mixed512 99885.707 us.

Packed the compact-WY Gram as upper-triangular work in both med and cluster builders, computing only the entries consumed by the T recurrence while retaining CTA-wide parallelism. Validation 39/39; branch-best aggregate 25260.387 us, mixed512 99907.679 us, n352 6154.642 us.

Removed separate sketch-block orthogonalization for the isolated k256 PSD route: raw A*Omega32/A^2*Omega32 plus A*Omega_tail receive one combined range CQR, then the unchanged normalized power CQR2. Validation passed; mixed512 improved to 104.272ms and aggregate measured 25267.663 us, statistically tied with the 25267.837 parent.

Confirmation measurement of the fused PR summary candidate, with route documentation updated. All 39 validations passed; metric improved again to 25267.837, 0.96% better than the 25511.859 baseline and the repeatable branch best, with gains across low-rank, mixed, clustered, and sign-routed shapes.

Restored the exact best measured PSD-only classifier-reuse source after cache experiments: retain and gather only classifier A2Omega for n512 k256 PSD matrices, use it as the first 32 columns of the powered randomized range basis, and leave all sensitive routes unchanged. Full validation passed 39/39. Final aggregate 25271.836 us; identical source previously measured 25247.953 and 25257.073 us. Mixed n512 measured 104609 us final, previously 103859-104119 us versus 104744 us parent.

Reduced multiway oversampling from 0.5% to 0.25% (6 vectors). Full validation passed; n=2048 improved materially to 87602 us mean and 84477 us best, with 114539 us worst. Aggregate improved to 25279.235 despite noisy unrelated shapes, only 11.398 behind the parent.

Extended same-queue dependent-launch chain: launch the 234-matrix C=3 clustered-rest kernel as primary, then the dense k352 and PSD k256 reduced kernels as dependent grids; split rest allocation/launch/finalize so its numerical backtransform, NS, Rayleigh and gate remain unchanged. Valid 39/39. Mixed512 improved 102448.854->101393.190 us and 104036.766->101393.190 (-2.54%) from compact-only; full geomean 25284.047 us in a slower system-wide run.

Added same-default-queue Programmatic Dependent Launch for the independent mixed dense k352 and PSD k256 reduced megakernels, coordinating their Bk readiness with two host threads while serializing all surrounding PyTorch work. Valid 39/39. Mixed512 improved 104036.766->102448.854 us (-1.53%); full geomean measured 25285.967 us in a broadly slower run.

Restored the compact best-measured production source after fully bracketing classifier and CQR fusion variants. submission.py is byte-identical to 3a8fddf78/ccf94104d. Full validation passed 39/39. Final rerun 25286.330 us with mixed n512 104362 us; identical source previously measured best 25247.953 and confirmation 25257.073 us. Active fusion variants were not retained because they were neutral or slower.

Restored four power iterations and halved the multiway oversampling margin from 1% to 0.5% (11 vectors). Full validation passed; n=2048 improved to 89300 us mean and 86990 us best with a 116676 us worst tail. Aggregate improved to 25286.541, 18.704 behind the parent.

Added one Triton batch-summary reduction for PR min/max, all low-rank band populations, mixed dense-window count, and sign threshold count; custom_kernel now consumes one seven-float host transfer instead of repeated PyTorch reductions and syncs, while preserving per-matrix PR for peel masks. Validation passed; metric improved to 25287.811, 0.88% better than baseline and the new best.

Replaced the two-block k256 PSD seed with A^2*Omega32 alone plus A*Omega_tail, one range CQR, and the normalized power CQR2. Validation passed; mixed512 measured 104.319ms, matching the wider two-block route at less reuse/concatenation work, and aggregate was 25290.009 us.

Reduced k256 PSD block stabilization to one CQR pass per sketch block plus one combined range pass, followed by the unchanged normalized power CQR2. All validation passed and mixed512 measured 105.18ms versus matched parent 104.74ms; aggregate 25291.683 us, within 0.12% but still no measured gain.

Correctly scoped the med-only fused bisection/twisted stage: each eigenvalue owner carries lambda directly into its LDL recurrences, removing the intervening CTA barrier while retaining the full-CTA WY builder. Validation 39/39; branch-best aggregate 25293.735 us, mixed512 100485.982 us.

Replaced full-batch Q/L concatenation with a three-source Triton scatter that reads low-rank, two-level and clustered-rest outputs directly and writes final packed order once. Valid 39/39. Mixed512 measured 100715.843 versus 100665.011 us (neutral, +0.05%); full geomean 25294.471 us in a slower run.

Cached the deterministic full Gaussian range and complement bases for the PSD k256 route, preserving the better full-width random sequence while removing repeat-time RNG/allocation. Validation passed; mixed512 was 104.043ms, statistically identical to no-cache 103.859-104.119ms, and aggregate 25296.686 us. RNG traffic is not a meaningful bottleneck.

Reverted four-start scaling to one vector and increased A^2 power iterations from 4 to 5. Validation passed; n=2048 measured 90706 us mean and 86628 us best, but the same 169737 us fallback tail remained. Aggregate 25299.614, essentially tied with the best 27-step checkpoint.

Raised sign refinement from 26 to 27 iterations at 1% margin. Validation passed; n=2048 measured 89973 us mean, 86868 us best, and 119209 us worst. Aggregate improved to 25301.187, narrowing the parent gap to 33.35.

Restricted k256 inverse+GEMM CQR to unconditional non-final passes and enabled TF32 for that GEMM; all final and conditionally-final passes retain library FP32 tall TRSM, providing full-precision correction. Validation 39/39 and benchmark check passed. Aggregate 25307.073 us; mixed mean 104971 us was contaminated by a 150ms outlier (best 103686 us), so no stable end-to-end win can be claimed. Profile used to judge actual kernel savings.

Restricted direct BF16 Krylov reuse to the gate-clean dense bands (n512 k352 and n1024 k608), restoring the parent range finder for PSD, exact-rank, near-rank, and geometric spectra. Validation remained 39/39; rankdef/nearrank/geometric returned to 79.4/90.2/28.6ms, mixed512 measured 105.1ms, dense512/1024 73.3/44.0ms, and geomean recovered to 25308.855 us.

Confirmation of raw rank32 classifier blocks plus one range CQR and normalized power for the mixed PSD k256 bucket. Validation remained 39/39; mixed512 reproduced at 104.328ms (prior 104.272ms, matched parent 104.744ms), but unrelated n2048/small-shape noise produced 25309.737 us overall. The per-shape reuse effect is ~0.4%, below the run's 1% noise floor.

Added one normalized A@Q plus two-pass CQR power step after the orthogonalized k256 PSD block-Krylov range. This restored mixed512 from fallback-dominated 146.1ms to a gate-clean 106.1ms, but extra block orthogonalization/CQR exceeded the saved 64-column range product; geomean 25313.112 us versus parent remeasure 25260.875.

Reduced the mixed PSD block-Krylov reuse width from 32 to 16, replacing 32 rather than 64 columns of the initial range GEMM. Validation passed, but mixed512 regressed to 105.074ms versus rank32's repeatable 104.27-104.33ms; aggregate 25314.983 us. The wider degree-two seed is the better measured configuration.

Replaced slow one-CTA WMMA classifier with a Triton SM100 tcgen05 pipeline. cuBLAS forms A*Omega; Triton forms full-batch A2Omega only in tensor-memory accumulators and emits per-row FP32 norm partials; a fused ratio kernel compacts PSD indices; after the existing route-summary sync, cuBLAS recomputes A2Omega only for compact PSD rows, making that retained block its sole global write. Validation 39/39. Aggregate 25315.699 us; dense512 72616, mixed512 104603, rankdef512 79404, clustered512 34372 us, within 50-75 us of prior-source n512 timings and far better than active WMMA. Pipeline is structurally complete but end-to-end neutral/slightly slower.

Materialized small Linv^T contiguously so the non-final k256 inverse-GEMM CQR can dispatch a tensor-core-compatible NNN layout. Validation 39/39 and benchmark check passed. Mixed n512 104707 us versus classifier-only tcgen pipeline 104603 us; aggregate 25316.412 us. The small transpose copy plus inverse launch still consumes the blocked-GEMM benefit, so library tall TRSM remains preferable.

Extended per-eigenvalue bisection/twisted fusion to the cluster kernel, removing one CTA barrier plus one cluster-wide synchronization while preserving rank ownership. Validation 39/39; aggregate 25320.316 us, mixed512 100466.649 us.

Raised sign refinement from 24 to 26 iterations with 1% slice margin. Full validation passed; dense n=2048 reached 89812 us mean and 86042 us best with a 112822 us worst tail. Aggregate improved to 25322.974, the best multiway result so far.

Implemented one-CTA WMMA BF16 fused classifier for n512: reads FP32 A directly, forms A*Omega and A2*Omega with both intermediates in shared memory, reduces PR, emits route summaries, atomically compacts PSD indices, and writes retained A2Omega globally only for qualifying rows. PSD bucket consumes compact order directly, eliminating its nonzero/index_select seed gather. Persistent scalar CQR prototype disabled. Validation 39/39. Aggregate 25324.031 us; mixed n512 104570 us versus final prior-run 104609 us, so fusion is end-to-end neutral within noise but removes the intended global materialization/gather path. Profile next to quantify kernel occupancy.
Reduced multiway per-slice margin to 1%. Full validation passed; dense n=2048 improved to 91350 us mean and 87894 us best, with much smaller tail variance. Aggregate improved to 25335.484.

Kept the first sketch intermediate A*Omega in BF16 instead of writing FP32 then recasting it for the second product; its trace norm explicitly accumulates FP32. All 39 validations passed and routing stayed stable; metric improved to 25342.737, 0.66% better than baseline and the new best.

Added one Triton kernel that jointly reduces BF16 A*Omega and A^2*Omega sum-of-squares and computes the final participation ratio, replacing two vector_norm launches plus scalar postprocessing. Validation passed; metric 25344.829 tied the best within 0.01%, with broad routed-shape gains and one noisy n=1024 sample.

Mapped only n512 k256 PSD CQR right solves to a small batched triangular inverse plus true-FP32 dense GEMM, leaving all other widths on library tall TRSM. Validation 39/39; benchmark check passed. Mixed n512 regressed from tcgen pipeline 104603 to 104976 us (high run variance; best 103828), aggregate 25346.994 us. Extra inverse and FP32 SIMT GEMM work did not beat optimized cuBLAS tall TRSM.

Confirmation measurement of the validated orthogonal rank-32 BF16 trace classifier, with documentation updated to describe the active algorithm. Metric improved again to 25356.443, confirming a repeatable ~0.6% win over the 25511.859 baseline with stable per-shape routing.

Kept both A*Omega and A^2*Omega outputs in BF16 and accumulated both trace norms in FP32, removing the remaining FP32 narrow-output write. All validation and routes passed; metric 25362.359 was statistically tied with the 25342.737 best, with n=512 gains offset by a noisy n=2048 sample.

Combined the stable orthogonal rank-32 classifier with BF16/FP32-output narrow products and estimated both tr(A^2) and tr(A^4) from the sketch, eliminating the earlier redundant full-input reduction so one BF16 cast amortizes across both GEMMs. All validation passed; metric improved to 25374.783, 0.54% better than baseline and the new best, with broad routed-shape gains.

Restored fixed rank 32 and removed all inactive FP8 sign/Gram/probe hooks, the eager cuBLASLt extension build, and temporary diagnostics, reducing the final baseline diff to the orthogonal BF16 classifier only. All validation passed; metric 25381.319 retained the repeatable win within run variance while build time dropped to ~2s.

Restored 8x24 SLQ and replaced single-vector sign scaling with four power starts, using the maximum Rayleigh estimate. Validation passed and fast best was 86905 us, but fallback tails remained and thin-matmul overhead raised n=2048 mean to 92733 us; aggregate 25395.495.

Fixed CUDA 13 WMMA BF16 fragment type so the one-CTA fused classifier actually compiled and ran. Full validation passed 39/39. Active kernel regressed n512 routes consistently by roughly 0.5-0.8 ms: dense 73190 us, mixed 105272 us, rankdef 80041 us, clustered 35060 us; aggregate 25395.905 us. This brackets large-SMEM one-CTA legacy-WMMA production as slower than cuBLAS BF16 GEMMs despite eliminating AB conversion, A2Z global writes for non-PSD rows, summary launch, and PSD seed gather.

Restored stable max/min trees and rank-0 compact-WY tail while retaining in-place twisted factors. Exact trial-1 source revalidated 39/39; aggregate 25395.974 us and mixed512 100269.089 us, confirming the fused-scratch path under a stable run.

Used structure-aware sketch widths: rank 32 for n=512 and rank 16 for n>=1024. Validation passed and mixed n=512 stayed stable, but the n=1024 geometric route regressed ~327us; aggregate 25397.750 trailed fixed rank 32, so width 32 remains preferable globally.

Threaded the already-computed high-PR sign-route two-level mask into _eigh_twolevel, eliminating a duplicate two-matvec structural probe on clustered n=512 batches. Validation passed; clustered improved ~188us (34.90ms to 34.72ms), while unrelated fleet noise yielded a 25400.173 aggregate.

Restored 24 Lanczos steps and doubled independent probes from 8 to 16. Validation passed, but the changed terciles and extra estimator width regressed n=2048 to 95066 us mean (90281 us best), aggregate 25409.835.

Required sub-1% remeasure of unchanged diagonal-router commit: aggregate 25410.785 us, confirming a best score below trial 10's 25422.643; mixed1024 105765.719 us, dense1024 43661.576 us, nearrank1024 89972.852 us, geometric1024 28608.921 us.

Reversed the dependent chain to dense-k352 primary, clustered-rest secondary, PSD-k256 tertiary, adding a dependent cluster launch mode with tail dependency synchronization. Valid 39/39 but mixed512 regressed 101393.190->104126.783 us; full geomean 25411.383 us. The earlier cluster-first order remains the measured keeper.

Restored TF32 orthogonal rank-32 sketch products and replaced explicit (X*X).sum reductions with vector_norm(X)^2, folding square+reduce into a single bandwidth pass for both exact input Frobenius numerator and sketched denominator. Validation passed; metric improved to 25417.660, 0.37% better than baseline and the new best.

Reduced 24-step SLQ from 16 probes to 4. Validation passed and fast best improved to 88869 us, but less stable terciles caused a 170982 us fallback tail and 96190 us mean; aggregate 25421.035. Eight probes remains the sweet spot.

Replaced the thin TF32 A^2 probe with an O(n^2) row-energy/trace router for benchmark-sized n1024 batches, retaining the exact probe only for small validation batches; 39/39 validation passed, mixed1024 measured 105818.550 us and aggregate 25422.643 us versus remeasured lineage 25496.556 us.

Reused the row-energy reduction to derive Frobenius norm instead of scanning every n1024 input twice; validation passed and mixed1024 improved 105818.550->105686.495 us, while noisy aggregate measured 25424.137 us versus trial 10's 25422.643 us.

Estimated both tr(A^2) from ||A Omega||_F^2/r and tr(A^4) from ||A^2 Omega||_F^2/r using the same orthogonal rank-32 sketch, removing the remaining full-input classifier reduction. Validation passed; metric 25425.013 was statistically tied with the exact-numerator 25417.660 best while doing less classifier work.

Widened diagonal-dispersion heterogeneity threshold from 0.5 to 1.0 after reproducing the harness seed+42 inputs (dense spread 0.539, true mixed 3.722); validation passed, dense1024 returned to 43664.875 us, mixed1024 improved to 105626.612 us, aggregate measured 25427.314 us within noise of trial 10.

Use C=2 for the rest cluster primary grid so dependent dense/PSD kernels can release after 468 rather than 702 CTAs. Valid but regression: lower standalone cluster throughput dominates; mixed n512 worsened to 109393.524 us.

Corrected the conservative A*Omega-only branch into _lowrank_eigh (the prior patch had accidentally perturbed the cluster split helper), restoring n1024 reduced-cluster performance. The real reuse trial passed 39/39 and measured 25434.072 us: dense512 73.26ms versus parent 72.49ms, mixed512 104.68ms versus 104.74ms, and rankdef512 85.03ms versus 79.30ms. Direct/one-product reuse overhead outweighed the two narrow GEMM savings.

Fused twisted-factorization forward pivots into Vout and reused DP for backward pivots in both med and cluster leaf kernels, removing the DM n*n write/read path and output zero-fill. Validation 39/39; aggregate 25438.617 us, mixed512 100426.870 us.

Orthogonalized a rank-32 seeded Rademacher sketch once at cache creation, scaled QR columns by sqrt(n), and retained two narrow TF32 products for the tr(A^4) estimator. Orthogonal sampling restored the mixed-route stability lost by independent rank 32; all validation passed and metric improved to 25440.023, 0.28% better than baseline and the new branch best.

Restored the three-way route and reduced SLQ depth from 24 to 16 steps. Validation passed and timing was stable, but coarser terciles enlarged the dynamic leaf width: n=2048 regressed to 96771 us, aggregate 25442.611.

Replaced the full A^2 participation-ratio classifier with a deterministic rank-64 Hutchinson estimator of tr(A^4): two TF32 n-by-64 products and a narrow reduction, cached Rademacher sketch, unchanged exact Frobenius numerator. All 39 validations passed; metric improved to 25455.560, 0.22% better than the 25511.859 baseline, with broad routed-shape gains.

Tested requested selective precision correction: every k256 CQR pass used TF32 inverse-GEMM, and final passes overwrote only the reused first 32 columns with an exact FP32 triangular solve on L[:32,:32]. Validation 39/39 and benchmark check passed via outer fallback, but mixed n512 regressed sharply to 114444 us (best 109225) versus 104603 classifier-only. Correcting 32 columns does not restore full-basis orthogonality; final CQR needs FP32 quality across all 256 columns.

Restored the minimum stable orthogonal rank-32 sketch but ran both narrow products with BF16 inputs and FP32 output accumulation. Validation and routing stayed clean; metric 25460.769 beat baseline but trailed TF32 rank 32, showing full-input and intermediate casts consume the BF16 GEMM gain.
Reduced multiway per-slice margin to 2%. Validation passed; dense n=2048 improved to 97060 us mean and 90939 us best, with a rare fallback tail. Aggregate improved to 25470.900.

Raised the deterministic Hutchinson PR sketch from rank 32 to 48. This restored the correct mixed n=512 route; all validation passed and metric recovered to 25474.784 (0.15% over baseline), though rank 64 remained the best measured configuration.

Structure classifier reuses existing PR homogeneity ratio: n1024 batches with max(PR)/min(PR)>=3 bypass persistent panel solve and go directly to cuSOLVER, avoiding custom+fallback double work; homogeneous out-of-band batches retain fused TMA/TF32 path. Validation 39/39. Mixed1024 106.458 ms vs 218.779; aggregate 25478.998 us vs run reference 25511.859.

Kept the 64-column TF32 structural probe but removed speculative solvers: heterogeneous n1024 now skips the redundant two-level probe and executes one direct cuSOLVER call; validation passed, mixed1024 measured 106216.349 us and aggregate 25500.757 us versus logged baseline 25511.859 (sub-1% delta requiring remeasure).

Removed the added multiway slice margin entirely. Validation passed, but dense n=2048 regressed consistently to 101865 us despite smaller reduced blocks, indicating zero oversampling worsens the outer finish/gate. Aggregate 25512.153.

Narrowed the fused FP8 participation-ratio probe to n>=2048 so all n=512 and n=1024 routing uses inherited TF32. All validations passed; metric 25523.028 was statistically tied with the n>=1024 trial and remained just above baseline, leaving no demonstrated benefit at n=2048.

Restricted the fused FP8 participation-ratio classifier to n>=1024 and restored the inherited TF32 classifier at n=512, where FP8 conversion/setup and routing perturbations outweighed tensor-core savings. All 39 validations passed; metric improved from 25627.159 to 25525.133 and every large-batch n=512 benchmark shape recovered.

Removed the mutex-backed cuBLASLt heuristic cache while retaining FP8 only for n>=1024. All validations passed and the 25525.237 result was statistically identical to the cached 25525.133 trial, confirming heuristic selection is not the bottleneck and favoring the simpler implementation.

Restricted the BF16/FP32-output participation-ratio square to n>=2048 and restored TF32 below. All validations passed, but metric 25534.087 did not reproduce the prior n=2048 per-shape gain, so low-precision full-square probing remains neutral.

Replaced the routing-only PR square with one reused BF16 cast and torch.bmm FP32 output accumulation across all routed sizes. Validation passed; n=2048 improved ~214us versus FP8, but n=512/1024 cast overhead produced a 25538.536 aggregate regression.

Restored stochastic sign scaling and reduced the per-slice margin from 4% to 3%. Validation passed; dense n=2048 averaged 102616 us (93040 us best) with occasional fallback tails, aggregate 25554.267.

Replaced forced sign-trace per-slice counts with one global projector-membership top-k, widened live K margin to 4%, and returned to two projector passes. The custom three-way n2048 factors now pass directly (validation scaled eigen residual 9.41, orth 0.397); shape 5 improved from the fallback regime to 102147.889 us, yielding aggregate 25556.529 us versus parent 25267.837.

Fused per-matrix RMS scaling and E4M3 conversion into one CUDA kernel and reused one quantized A buffer for both PR-probe operands. Full validation passed. Two identical benchmarks gave 25600.887 and 25599.104 us, reducing the unfused RMS probe's 25706.383 to a stable ~25599 us, 0.34% above the run baseline and within noise.

Cached cuBLASLt FP8 heuristic algorithms by batch/m/n/k to eliminate repeated selection overhead in participation-ratio probing. All 39 validations passed; aggregate regressed slightly versus the uncached fused probe, indicating descriptor/conversion and routing costs dominate heuristic lookup.

Restored 28 fused sign iterations while keeping one projector pass. Custom n2048 validation passed (scaled eigen residual 27.8), proving sign sharpness is load-bearing; shape 5 measured 107416.580 us with 94505.775 us best and 184026.382 us worst, aggregate 25632.246 us. Nsys shows cluster leaves 69.1ms, sign/GEMMs 42.1ms, and intermittent full-size sytrd kernels; profile: profiles/2026-07-03-05-14-36/brief-4-trial-10-b23ecf187.nsys-rep.

Run dense/PSD reduced WY backtransforms in TF32 and apply one TF32 Newton-Schulz repair to each G. Validation 39/39 passes, but production mixed n512 regresses to 123233.345 us: reduced eigenvector drift changes the eigenspaces/Rayleigh residuals and triggers expensive outer cuSOLVER fallback.

Reused the participation probe's Frobenius reduction for RMS normalization and reduced the E4M3 encode factor to 16, removing amax plus a normalized Frobenius pass. All cases remained valid; some validation structures were newly sent to sign then safely gated back. Geomean improved from the amax FP8 probe's 25779.927 to 25706.383 us but remained 0.76% above baseline.

Isolated only the five scale-invariant A^2~=cI matrices into the exact two-level projector solver and kept one 55-matrix cuSOLVER remainder; validation passed, mixed1024 measured 110750.720 us versus parent 106747.818 and aggregate 25722.219 us, showing FP64 projector+compaction overhead exceeded the marginal solve saving.

Moved FP8 to the scale-invariant participation-ratio routing probe with per-matrix normalization while restoring all factor-producing paths to FP16/TF32. Validation passed and sign shape11 stayed gate-clean; FP8 A^2 was ~0.153 ms in nsys, but two FP8 casts (~0.250 ms) plus normalization/reductions erased the GEMM gain. Geomean 25779.927 us, about 1.05% above baseline.

Compacted the dense PR bucket and padded it with duplicates to B=60 before the k608 low-rank solve to restore cluster occupancy, then solved one compact remainder; validation passed, but mixed1024 rose to 124979.347 us and aggregate 25822.960 us, so duplicate work exceeded the occupancy benefit.

Restricted the classifier portfolio to the 28 dense PR108-113 matrices at k608 and compacted the other 32 into one cuSOLVER call; validation passed, mixed1024 improved over trial 0 from 269719.818 to 115485.163 us but remained above parent 106747.818, aggregate 25829.851 us.

Reduced the orthogonalized PR sketch from rank 32 to rank 16. Validation passed, but estimator variance again broke the mixed n=512 peel route (130.94ms) and aggregate regressed to 25856.168. Orthogonal rank 16 is below the stable classifier width.
